page_title: Winds: A Beautiful Open Source RSS & Podcast App

summary.name: Winds
summary.one_liner: Winds is an open-source RSS reader and podcast app powered by Stream, which has since been sunset and is no longer supported.
keywords: read podcasts and rss in one app
use_cases: Reading RSS feeds and podcasts in one interface
Migrating subscriptions from another RSS manager via OPML
Studying an open-source RSS and podcast app codebase
summary.what_it_does: Winds is an open-source application, powered by Stream, for reading RSS feeds and listening to podcasts in a single interface. Users can import their subscriptions by exporting an OPML file from another RSS manager and importing it into Winds. The page says it uses Stream's machine learning to build a personalized activity feed based on user preferences. The project is built with React, Redux, and Node.js, and the page says it uses Algolia for search and MongoDB for data storage. The page states that Winds has been sunset and is no longer supported, and links to the archived GitHub repository.
notable: Open source codebase built with React, Redux, and Node.js
OPML import for moving subscriptions from other RSS managers
Combined RSS reading and podcast listening
Personalized activity feed powered by Stream's machine learning
caveats: Winds has been sunset and is no longer supported
Source repository is archived on GitHub
